About Us

Landscaping and Hardscape Installation in Lawrence, KS

From custom patios, walkways, and retaining walls to artificial turf, putting greens, privacy fences, and deck construction, each improvement can be planned around the property's layout and the homeowner's needs.

Quality outdoor construction begins with proper site preparation, accurate measurements, suitable materials, and careful attention to drainage and grading. Whether you want to improve an underused backyard, create a comfortable outdoor living area, enhance privacy, or reduce routine lawn maintenance, the right combination of landscaping features can make your property more practical and inviting.

Hardscape design also considers surface durability, soil conditions, water movement, and the connection between built features and existing landscaping. Retaining Wall Installation in Lawrence, KS
